{{Quote|Here is the location of the cave where I think the brutes might be hiding. Now please save my family, and do be careful.|A moisture farmer|<ref name="SWG:TMotH" />}}
The '''Beetle Cave''' was a [[Cave/Legends|cave]] located on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. During the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the cave was used as a base of operations for a group of [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] known as the [[Sennex]].

==Description==
The Beetle Cave was located a relatively short distance south of the planet's [[Oasis East|eastern oasis]], and some distance east of the [[Great Mesra Plateau/Legends|Great Mesra Plateau]] and northeast of [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]]. The cave was populated by numerous [[cave beetle]]s, [[rock beetle]]s, and [[Dune beetle/Legends|dune beetles]].<ref name="SWG:BC" />

==History==
{{Quote|We've been told stories all about it. My grandpa said he knew where one used to live. He said he found the Dragon in the cave and punched it in the nose. My grandpa's a good guy and he wouldn't lie, no-siree!|A commoner|<ref name="SWG:ac">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=herald|a commoner|Tatooine}}</ref>}}
A commoner from [[Mos Entha/Legends|Mos Entha]] claimed that around [[80 BBY/Legends|80 years]] prior to the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], [[Gender/Legends|his]] grandfather saw a [[Krayt dragon/Legends|krayt dragon]] in the [[Cave/Legends|cave]] and [[Unarmed combat/Legends|punched]] it in the [[Nose/Legends|nose]]. The commoner gave the coordinates of the cave to the [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]], where the [[Skeleton/Legends|skeletal]] remains of the dragon could be found.<ref name="SWG:ac" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> the cave was used as a base of operations by a violent gang of [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] known as the [[Sennex]]. When the wife and daughter of a [[Moisture farmer/Legends|moisture farmer]] were kidnapped and held captive inside the base for ransom, he begged a [[Hero of Tatooine|spacer]] to [[Quest of the Hero of Tatooine|rescue]] them. The spacer succeeded in doing so, and received the [[Mark of Altruism]] as a result.<ref name="SWG:TMotH" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Beetle Cave was a location in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:BC" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> During one of the herald quests given by a commoner, the datapad coordinators referred to this location as a '''Mysterious Cave'''.<ref name="SWG:ac" />
